title: How many points does the player have?
instruction: Step through the game’s code. What value does the variable have now?
debrief: Set overwrites the value, change adds to whatever is there. Set belongs at the start of the game, change belongs to catching a coin.

code: when the game starts: set score to 0
when the game starts: set lives to 3
when the player picks up a coin: change score by 1
when the character crashes: change lives by -1
when a new level starts: set lives to 3

steps.why: Set overwrites the value with 0, whatever was there.
Each coin adds 1 to what is there: 0 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 3.

steps.input: The character crashed into an enemy.
steps.why: Change by -1 takes one of the three away.
One of the two is taken away.
Set overwrites the value with 3, no matter how many were left.
Line 5 only changes the lives. Nothing overwrote the score, so it stayed at 3.

rounds.title: The programmer made a mistake
code: when the game starts: set score to 0
when the player picks up a coin: set score to 1

steps.why: Set to 1 overwrites the value with 1 every time. However many coins the player picks up, the score is always 1. It should be change by 1.
